implementation_strategy: Execute the paired confirmatory protocol using hosted LLM API (openai_responses:gpt-5-mini) for all generation steps and Dockerized verifier/emulator components for deterministic validation. Pipeline: (1) deterministic preprocessing (interface canonicalization, slot mapping); (2) single-turn LLM call per intent to produce a shared initial candidate (baseline and shared_initial_candidate for guarded); (3) parse and deterministic template->vendor-agnostic translation; (4) static syntactic checks; (5) pass to Batfish running in Docker for semantic verification; (6) if verifier fails and iteration cap not reached, invoke one guarded repair LLM call (generate_validate_repair_v1) and re-run parsing/verification; (7) if syntactic parsing fails, trigger automatic rejection and record failure code; (8) emulate accepted configs in Mininet-style Docker containers with FRRouting and VyOS images for emulation-grounded reachability/policy checks. All steps automated, no human labour. Model calls limited to at most 2 per task (initial + one repair). All artifacts, hashes, and deterministic timeouts recorded and archived.
public_resources: Mininet-style emulation images (Docker) with FRRouting and VyOS images
Public NL→config corpora referenced in preregistration (evidence_record_ids in preregistration)
Repository with pipeline code, unit tests, and mapping rules (to be published alongside paper)
task_manifest_strategy: Select N=200 confirmatory multi-device intents stratified by topology cluster per preregistration: 2-device:80, 3–4 devices:80, 5–8 devices:40. Reserve separate discovery set of 50 intents. Deterministic selection using SHA-256 deduplication and random seed 42. Exclude exact-hash matches to public corpora; flag >80% n-gram overlap for sensitivity analyses. Each confirmatory intent yields a paired baseline vs guarded outcome.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline: direct_configuration_generation_v1 (single-turn LLM generation -> deterministic template fill -> vendor_agnostic_to_frr_v1 translation -> static checks). Guarded: generate_validate_repair_v1 (same initial candidate shared, run Batfish verification; if failing, single verifier-guided repair call; deterministic parsing and re-verification; cap repairs at 1). All transformations implemented as deterministic code modules with unit tests and frozen random seed where applicable.
execution_batches: 10 batches of 20 confirmatory intents each (batch_size=20 → 10*20=200 confirmatory intents). Each batch executes baseline and guarded episodes for its tasks sequentially; worst-case model calls per batch = 40, total worst-case = 400.
Separate exploratory batch for 50 discovery intents executed after confirmatory run.
randomisation_plan: Stratified deterministic sampling with seed=42. Confirmatory allocation: 2-device cluster 80 intents, 3–4 devices 80 intents, 5–8 devices 40 intents. Within-cluster selection randomized with seed=42. No adaptive re-sampling; sampling freeze archived.
caching_plan: Cache all LLM responses, Batfish outputs, and emulation traces on durable storage with SHA-256 manifests. Reuse cached verifier/emulator outputs only for identical inputs (exact-match) to avoid extra model calls. Cache TTL tied to run; caches archived and hashed with run artifacts.
failure_recovery_plan: Deterministic technical retries only: LLM call timeout retried once immediately (per missingness_plan). Batfish verification uses a single verification attempt per submission (timeout 120s); if Docker container fault occurs, attempt container restart once; repeated container fatal errors halt execution per stopping_rule and affected pairs marked per missingness_plan. No human adjudication. All failures logged with deterministic error codes and archived.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1: per-intent record containing intent_id, topology_cluster, baseline_outcome (semantic-error: boolean), guarded_outcome (semantic-error: boolean), baseline_model_calls (int), guarded_model_calls (int), iterations_to_pass (0..3 capped), verifier_outputs (hashed), emulator_outputs (hashed), failure_codes (if any), artifact_hashes. Primary estimand computed by paired_binary_analysis_v1 (McNemar two-sided test) with 95% bootstrap CI for absolute paired success-rate difference.
estimated_compute_notes: Model-call estimate: expected 300 hosted LLM calls (200 initial + estimated 100 repair calls given historical failure rate assumptions); adapter upper bound = 400 calls (task_count*2). Batfish and emulation run in Docker on CPU-only hosts; no GPU required. Wall-clock execution target <= 7 days; storage estimate ~20 GB for archived verifier/emulator traces and model-response artifacts. All compute fits frozen capability manifest (hosted_model_api_available true, docker_available true, local_gpu unavailable).
